name: Weather Demo
author: SmartinfoLogiks
description: Demo plugin: an admin component calling this plugin's own backend service, which calls the Open-Meteo weather API and logs each lookup to the plugin's own table. Also seeds a public-site Service and a `weather-current` component, so a visitor-facing page can show the latest lookup too.

default_city.label: Default city
default_city.help: Pre-fills the city box, and is used when a lookup is requested with no city given.
